correctness.rationale: The full family has frame operator [[2,1],[1,1]] with determinant one. The erased singleton {e1} satisfies the K-frame identity exactly for K=P_{span(e1)}. Direct matrix multiplication gives I-S_J^{-1}S_I=[[1,0],[-1,0]], which is singular and sends e1 outside R(K). The corrected criterion follows immediately from the K-g-frame definition and Douglas' factorization theorem.

value.rationale: The theorem is presented as the paper's exact redundancy test for deciding whether erasing coefficients preserves a K-g-frame. Its condition actually detects ordinary g-frame invertibility and rejects a remaining Parseval K-frame in the smallest nontrivial dimension. The corrected positive-operator/range criterion is exact and preserves the intended K-frame generality.
